site.name: SiteTwin revision: 4.5G
notes: SiteTwin application: South-east sector boosted to 60 W per band for new apartments; antennas kept low on a flat roof

Synthetic sample for SiteTwin 3D, near Meta's Menlo Park campus. Antenna data and network KPIs are invented; the location is an ordinary city block. It is checked against Turkey's BTK limits like every site here: the US FCC limits are looser and not modelled.
Neighbouring buildings: 47 within 150 m from Microsoft building footprints; uses from OpenStreetMap (1 schools/health/childcare points).
Assumed, not in the SiteTwin file: antenna gain and beamwidths (typical values by band); antenna positions on the roof (sector edge).
